# --docs prints the embedded README, and a topic one of its sections, as
# plain Markdown when piped.
bit --docs
cmp stdout $ROOT/README.md

bit --docs ci
stdout '\A## CI workflows\n'
stdout '\[`large`\]\(#targets\)'
! stdout '\x1b'
! stdout '## Providers'

# An unknown topic is an error listing the topics there are.
! bit --docs no-such-topic
! stdout .
stderr '\Aerror: '
stderr 'unknown docs topic ''no-such-topic''; available topics:'
stderr '^  ci-workflows$'
